name: Photo Overlay
description: A client photo full-bleed with soft dark shading top and bottom, a white rating pill top-left, and a slightly tilted tone card along the bottom with the quote, name and detail.
bestFor: client review over their own photo
photoTip: The card covers the bottom quarter; keep faces in the top two-thirds.

tones.note: All six tones work; the card is the tone colour.

fields.label: Quote
fields.hint: Their words. Shrinks to fit; up to about 120 characters.

sample.label: Five stars
sample.quote: Worth every frame. We'll keep these forever.
sample.name: Priya & Sam
